scope: Retrospective sensitivity on two fixed datasets with a common seven-input contract. Prior outcomes from these exposed datasets are known. No prospective external validation or compute-time matching.
inner_cv: Within each dataset, sort FIT profile IDs, assign round-robin to three folds. Fit scaling, unconditional fixed-penalty ridge (for residual family), and booster exclusively on remaining FIT profiles. Score all fold-held profiles at historical training endpoint stride. Choose lowest mean per-profile OOF RMSE across pooled held profiles, ties resolved by listed order. Run selection separately per dataset, arm and family.
ridge_note: Fixed single regularization for both datasets, with no lambda search or use of a full-FIT-selected lambda inside validation folds. The two families differ only by this ridge and choice from the same tree grid.
training: Original 33 features, all FIT profiles, 300-row warmup, stride 5, profile-balanced tree and ridge losses; train-set residuals in degrees Celsius. Validation at 300::5 within FIT; evaluation later at 300::1 on every non-FIT role. Equal budget = three candidate scores on identical profile folds per family and arm, not equal CPU time.
evaluation: Refit each chosen model on all FIT profiles and score all historical non-FIT roles, without role outcomes used for tuning. Primary descriptive measure = profile-macro RMSE. Secondary = pooled RMSE and macro underestimation RMSE. Report every result, profile wins and paired changes. No significance tests or outcome-dependent grid extension.
